'''Proxida''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Julevia]] in the [[Julevian system]]. The system was located in the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] in a remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] stretch of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] – geographically part of the Outer Rim, but more akin to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] in practice. Proxida was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rock with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Julevian system]], except [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
